text: The Nova (OpenStack) repo in test-repo has no infrastructure files (no Dockerfiles, Terraform, or Kubernetes manifests) — all YAML files are provider test-data configs without apiVersion; infrastructure-analyzer correctly produces empty inventory on each run.

When a security-analyzer batch consists entirely of zero-byte __init__.py files, all 89 files will have empty candidateIds, zero candidates, zero gaps, and no findings — triage.json is {addressedVerdictRound:0, candidates:[], gaps:[]}.

Nova (OpenStack compute) source in test-repo has 1492 analysed Python files and 1 shell file; ruff+pylint+shellcheck+lizard all ran successfully; EXE002 fires on all 1491 Python files (filesystem permission artifact, not a code issue) and should be dropped as a group.
